hello.speaker: kojo
hello.text: You're the new A-214? Uncle Bright said you might come. I'm Kojo. That was my room — before.

choices.text: Nice to meet you, Kojo. How can I help?
Why are you waiting out here? Come in.
How do I know you are who you say you are?

gate.speaker: kojo
gate.text: I'm not a student here any more. Long story. This gate is as far as I go now.

careful.speaker: kojo
careful.text: Good. Don't trust everybody on this campus. Ask Uncle Bright — he knows my face.

story.speaker: kojo
story.text: When I left, they packed up my things and sent them to my family. Everything came back except my phone. Black Tecno, cracked in one corner, a Black Stars sticker on the back.

why.speaker: kojo
why.text: It's old. Probably useless. But there are photos on it I can't get anywhere else.

thanks.speaker: kojo
thanks.text: Thank you. Start with the room. I was always losing things in that wardrobe.

nothing.speaker: kojo
nothing.text: Nothing. I've got nothing to give you. …I'm asking anyway. Start with the wardrobe, if you bother.

wait.speaker: kojo
wait.text: I'll be around here. Take your time — I'm used to waiting at this gate.
